tasks.label: Jekyll (host, Docker): Start dev server
tasks.detail: Use this when running VS Code with Docker Desktop. Runs docker-compose.yml (same env as Codespaces).

tasks.label: Jekyll (host, Docker): Rebuild + start (after Gemfile change)
tasks.detail: Rebuild image (needed after editing Gemfile / Dockerfile.dev) then start. Host Docker only.

tasks.label: Jekyll (host, Docker): Build _site only
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm jekyll bundle exec jekyll build --drafts
tasks.detail: One-off production-style build into _site/ using the container (host Docker).

tasks.label: Jekyll (host, Docker): Update gems (rewrite Gemfile.lock)
tasks.detail: Runs: docker compose run --rm jekyll bundle update. Then commit Gemfile.lock and use 'Rebuild + start' (or make up) before serving locally.

tasks.label: Jekyll (Codespace / inside container): Start dev server
tasks.detail: Run this from inside a dev container or Codespace (you are already in the Ruby/gem environment). Starts the preview + LiveReload. Use the Ports panel or http://localhost:4000 (forwarded).

tasks.label: Jekyll (Codespace / inside container): Stop dev server
tasks.command: pkill -f 'jekyll serve' || pkill -f 'bundle exec jekyll' || echo 'No jekyll process found'
tasks.detail: Kill the running jekyll serve process (inside container).

tasks.label: Jekyll (Codespace / inside container): Rebuild _site only
tasks.detail: Run a full build into _site/. Fast inside the container because gems are pre-installed.

tasks.label: Jekyll (Codespace / inside container): Doctor / check
tasks.detail: Run jekyll doctor to check for configuration issues.
